name: Compatibility Matrices
description: Maintain compatibility matrices across desktop, PWA, SDK, plugins, and federation for each schema version.
purpose: Know exactly which surfaces support which schema versions.
acceptanceCriteria: Compatibility matrix format defined and documented
Matrix covers: desktop, PWA, SDK (all language bindings), plugins, federation endpoints
Each cell indicates supported schema versions (min, max, current)
Matrix is automatically generated or verified by CI
Incompatible combination surfaces a warning or blocks deployment
Historical matrix snapshots preserved for audit
